user.title: Lichtschnitzel
user.description: Address of the lamp, e.g. lichtschnitzel-a1b2c3.local. The password is only needed if the lamp has one for control.

confirm.description: Set up {name} at {host}? The password is only needed if the lamp has one for control.

reauth_confirm.description: The lamp refused the stored password. Enter the password for control.

error.password_needed: The lamp needs a password for control.
error.unknown: The lamp answered with an error.
error.unsupported_firmware: The lamp's firmware is too old or too new for this integration (it needs API version 2). Update the firmware and its web UI.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already set up.
abort.unsupported_firmware: The lamp's firmware is too old or too new for this integration (it needs API version 2). Update the firmware and its web UI.

set_parameter.name: Set effect parameter
set_parameter.description: Sets a parameter of the effect a screen shows, e.g. Speed or a colour. Values are clamped to the parameter's limits.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Id of the parameter: the "key" in the light's "parameters" attribute, e.g. speed or period_length.

value.name: Value
value.description: A number, or a colour as [r, g, b] or #rrggbb.

activate_scene.name: Activate scene
activate_scene.description: Switches the lamp to one of its scenes (named sets of all screens), by index or by name. Like every change it is live; the lamp starts with it only after Save state.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the scene; upper and lower case of A to Z do not matter.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a short signal on the chosen screens (doorbell, washer done), then every screen shows what it showed before. A screen light targets that screen, the lamp's own light all screens. It also shows while a screen or the lamp is off.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Flash (on and off), pulse (a smooth breath), chase (a comet running along the screen), bounce (a comet running there and back) or solid. Every pattern fades in and out over 0.3 s.

rgb_color.name: Colour
rgb_color.description: Colour of the signal; white without it.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of the signal; screen and lamp brightness do not dim it. 100 % without it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long, in seconds (at most 600). 0 ends a notification that is showing.

period.name: Period
period.description: One blink, breath or run in seconds; without it 0.6 (flash), 1.5 (pulse) 1 (chase) or 2 (bounce, there and back).

start.name: Start
start.description: First LED of the section, from the screen's start; negative counts from the end (-6: the last six LEDs). Whole screen without it.

length.name: Length
length.description: LEDs of the section; 0 or none runs to the end of the screen.

set_indicator.name: Set indicator
set_indicator.description: Shows a standing signal on the chosen screens until it is cleared, e.g. while the washer runs. Each has an ID; setting the same ID again changes it (e.g. a new progress). Without Start the indicators of a screen line up from its end. A screen light targets that screen, the lamp's own light all screens.

id.name: ID
id.description: Name of the indicator, 1 to 23 characters, e.g. washer. Used again to change or clear it.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Flash, pulse, chase, bounce or solid (default).

rgb_color.name: Colour
rgb_color.description: Colour of the indicator; white without it.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Its own brightness; screen and lamp brightness do not dim it. 100 % without it.

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: Optional: lights this share of the section as a bar, the rest dimly, e.g. from the remaining time.

start.name: Start
start.description: Optional: first LED of a fixed section (negative counts from the end). Without it the indicator lines up from the screen's end.

length.name: Length
length.description: LEDs of the indicator; 3 when it lines up, to the end of the screen at a fixed start.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: -100 to 100, default 0. Higher sits nearer the end of the screen; when there is no room, lower ones wait.

period.name: Period
period.description: One blink, breath or run in seconds.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional: clears itself after this many seconds (at most 600). Without it it stays until cleared.

clear_indicator.name: Clear indicator
clear_indicator.description: Removes an indicator from the chosen screens, or all indicators there without an ID.

id.name: ID
id.description: The indicator to remove; without it all of these screens.

not_a_screen.message: {entity} is not a screen of a Lichtschnitzel lamp.

scene_index_or_name.message: Give either index or name of the scene.

notify_unsupported.message: The lamp's firmware has no notifications or indicators yet; update it.

no_active_scene.message: No scene is active, so there is none to overwrite.
